# 4 Ezra Chapter 5 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — Signs and second dialogue

---

**1** Now concerning the signs: behold, the days will come when those who dwell upon earth shall be seized with great terror, and the way of truth shall be hidden, and the land shall be barren of faith.

**2** And iniquity shall be increased beyond what you yourself have seen, and beyond what you formerly heard of.

**3** And the land which you see ruling now shall become a trackless waste, and people shall see it forsaken.

**4** But if the Most High grants you to live, you shall see it disturbed after the third period: the sun shall suddenly shine by night, and the moon by day.

**5** And blood shall drip from wood, and the stone shall utter its voice; the peoples shall be troubled, and the stars shall fall.

**6** And a king shall reign whom those who dwell upon earth do not expect, and the birds shall take flight.

**7** And the sea of Sodom shall cast up fish; and one whom many do not know shall make his voice heard in the night, and all shall hear his voice.

**8** There shall be chaos in many places; fire shall break out frequently; wild beasts shall wander beyond their haunts; women with child shall bring forth monsters.

**9** And salt water shall be found in fresh springs, and all friends shall turn against one another; then understanding shall be hidden and insight withdrawn into its chamber,

**10** sought by many and not found; and unrighteousness and lawlessness shall be multiplied upon the earth.

**11** One country shall ask of another: Has righteousness passed through you, or one who does right? And it shall answer: No.

**12** And it shall be in that time that people shall hope but not obtain; they shall labor and their ways shall not prosper.

**13** These are the signs which I am permitted to tell you; and if you will pray again, and fast again seven days, I will tell you greater things than these.

**14** Then I awoke, and my body trembled greatly, and my soul was faint, for it had been held by great terror; but the angel who had come to speak with me held me and strengthened me and set me on my feet.

**15** And on the second night, Phaltiel, a chief of the people, came to me and said: Where were you? And why is your face sad?

**16** Do you not know that Israel has been entrusted to you in the land of their captivity?

**17** Rise then and eat some bread, and do not forsake us as a shepherd forsakes his flock into the power of fierce wolves.

**18** Then I said to him: Go away from me, and do not come near me for seven days; then come to me and I will tell you. And he departed.

**19** And I fasted seven days, mourning and weeping, as the angel Uriel had commanded me.

**20** And after seven days the thoughts of my heart were again very grievous to me,

**21** and my soul recovered the spirit of understanding, and I began to speak words of prayer before the Most High,

**22** and I said: O LORD our God, from every forest of the earth and from all its trees you chose one vine;

**23** and from all the lands of the whole world you chose one region; and from all the flowers of the world you chose one lily;

**24** and from all the depths of the sea you filled for yourself one river; and out of all the cities that have been built you sanctified Zion for yourself;

**25** and from all the birds that were created you named for yourself one dove; and from all the flocks that were made you provided for yourself one sheep;

**26** and from all the multitude of peoples you acquired for yourself one people; and to this people whom you loved you gave the law approved by all.

**27** And now, O LORD, why have you given over the many to the few, and dishonored the one root above the many, and scattered your own among the nations?

**28** And why have those who opposed your promises trampled down those who believe your covenants?

**29** If you so hate your own people, they should be punished by your own hands.

**30** Then the angel who had come to me on a previous night was sent again and said: Hear me, and I will instruct you; give heed, and I will tell you more.

**31** And I said: Speak, my lord. Then he said: Are you greatly troubled on account of Israel? Or do you love him more than his Maker?

**32** And I said: No, my lord, but out of grief I have spoken; for my heart pains me every hour while I labor to understand the way of the Most High and to search out part of his judgment.

**33** And he said: You cannot. And I said: Why then, my lord? For what purpose was I born? Or why was my mother's womb not my tomb, that I might not come to see the trouble of Jacob and the exhaustion of the race of Israel?

**34** And he said to me: Count for me those who have not yet come, and gather for me the scattered drops, and make fragrant for me the withered flowers,

**35** and open for me the locked chambers, and bring out for me the winds shut up within, and show me the image of a voice; and then I will show you the travail that you ask to see.

**36** And I said: O LORD who rules over us, who could know these things except one whose dwelling is not with men?

**37** But I am foolish; how then can I speak concerning the things you asked me?

**38** And he said: Just as you cannot do one of the things I mentioned, so also are you not able to find out my judgment, or the end of the love I have promised to my people.

**39** And I said: Yet behold, O LORD, you dwell over us, ready and prepared; your compassion is broad and you are near; for in all things your eye watches and your ear hears:

**40** show then to your servant why your judgment does not come by your right hand.

**41** And he answered me and said: This age the Most High made for many, but the age to come for few.

**42** I will tell you a comparison, Ezra: as when you ask the earth, it will say it yields much clay from which earthenware is made, but little dust from which gold comes — so also is the course of the present world.

**43** Then I said: Could you not have created at once both those who have been and those who are and those who shall be, so that you might have displayed your judgment the sooner?

**44** Then he answered me and said: The creature cannot hurry faster than the Creator, nor can the world hold at the same time all those who are to be created.

**45** Then I said: How has it been said to your servant that you will make alive at once those you have created — that those who are preserved in the earth shall all come together?

**46** And he said: Ask the womb of a woman and say: If you can bear ten children, why do you do so one at a time? Bid her then to bring forth ten at once.

**47** And I said: That she cannot do; only each one in its own time.

**48** Then said he: So also have I given the womb of the earth to those who are sown in it, each in their appointed time.

**49** For as a young girl does not give birth, and a woman who has grown old bears no more, so I have ordered the world which I created.

**50** And I inquired and said: Since you have now opened the door to me, show me yet further whether more things are to come after these. And he said: Yes.

**51** And I said: How long? And he said: What the left hand covers exceeds what the right covers.

**52** But I prayed to the Most High that he would grant to his servant the revelation of the Holy Spirit, and I wrote all the things I had seen in a book, which I deposited there with great care.
